summary: ITER 194 frontend-only PASS. All 6 flows + regression verified on mobile viewport (390×844) as super@test.com via /admin/login (session-bound). Tap 'Sync template options → bank' → 'Done' alert 'template: +0 new, 54 updated, 0 skipped' (idempotent). 'New Sponsored bid' modal opens with BMP chip pre-selected under 'Decider App', 'Your option to promote *' section renders the EXPECTED ownership-guard copy: 'No options in this app are linked to your Solution-Store listings yet. Publish a solution first (Solution Space → Solutions Store).' Modal closes cleanly. Bid creation NOT attempted (would 403 by design). FLOW 4 (/admin/ad-programs Publishers): New publisher (name 'Iter194 UI Pub', share 68) → creates DZ-PUB-9DE21822 → 'API credentials — shown ONCE' modal shows API Key dzk_38dffc74273b2c61 (public) + API Secret dzs_846811a70604c68d9e8453a33cdff409166eb4f97cac5c2c with copy icons + 'I've saved the secret' button. Publisher card afterwards shows tracker DZ-PUB-9DE21822 AND dzk_38dffc74273b2c61 row. 'Rotate keys' → 'Rotate API keys? The old key + secret stop working immediately.' confirm dialog with Cancel + Rotate; confirming shows a NEW one-time secret modal with a DIFFERENT key dzk_941d55d74d24dd04 (new secret dzs_281237d2aa6164d6…). Edit modal renders the new 'Linked Org ID (optional — enables the org-login portal)' field alongside Name/Site URL/Revenue share %. Publisher deleted at end (200). FLOW 5 (/adtaker-portal as super admin): shows the org-gate empty-state — globe icon + 'No publisher linked · This portal is for organization accounts. Ask the admin to link your org to a publisher.' (EXPECTED for non-org user); no crash. FLOW 6 (/decider-store): body text confirms 'AdMaker' + 'Publisher' hero pills next to the title; tapping the AdMaker pill navigates to /admaker-studio which loads the dashboard. REGRESSION: /admin/ad-programs Bids tab loads ('AdMaker Bids' + 'New bid' + 'No bids yet.'); Cutoffs tab loads ('Min Cutoff %' 60, 'Sponsored slots (N)' 3, 'Save global defaults' button + 'Per-node overrides (Central Catalog)' + catalog node search list); public /decider-store storefront still renders both 'Decider Apps · Finders' (1 · BMP with FINDER badge) and 'Decision Templates' (0 · 'No decision templates in this view yet.') sections.

issues: Hero pills 'AdMaker' and 'Publisher' render as small icon-only chips near the title (📣 + globe) at 390px width — the accessible text is present and taps correctly navigate, but visually the label text can be clipped/obscured behind the 'Home' button on mobile. Consider showing at least an icon+label on ≥360px or moving the pills into a sub-row below the tagline.
Decider App chip text is truncated to 'The 55 Business Model Patte…' — chips have maxWidth:220 with numberOfLines=1. Optional: allow horizontal scroll wrap or increase max width on the primary chip.

action_items: Optional UX polish: expose testID on the following interactive elements to make future E2E tests deterministic: (a) /admin/decider-store Bank action + 'Sync template options → bank' button + Option-Bank modal close; (b) /admin/ad-programs Cutoffs tab (text is clipped so text-selector needs a JS-startsWith walk); (c) /admaker-studio 'New Sponsored bid' primary button + Decider App chips inside the modal; (d) /decider-store hero pills 'AdMaker' + 'Publisher' (currently icon-only on ≤400px viewport).

Optional: address recurring react-native-web deprecation warnings (shadow* → boxShadow; props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents) — noise-only but pollutes DevTools.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Selectors that worked: `text=Bank` (exact=True), `text=Sync template options → bank`, `text=AdTaker Publishers`, `text=New publisher`, `text=/Create/i` (last), `text=New Sponsored bid`, `text=Run Finder`. GOTCHAS: (1) 'Cutoffs' tab label is clipped on 390px width — plain get_by_text('Cutoffs', exact=True) TIMES OUT; use JS `startsWith('Cutoffs')` + walk-up for cursor:pointer ancestor. (2) 'Rotate keys' text appears once per publisher card — locate by walking up from the publisher name element then querying inside the card subtree. (3) The 'Rotate' confirm button shares text with 'Rotate keys' on the cards; disambiguate by picking the last match (dialog is topmost). (4) 'Linked Org ID' field is inside BOTH New-publisher and Edit-publisher modals. (5) /decider-store hero pills 'AdMaker'/'Publisher' work by exact text (`get_by_text('AdMaker', exact=True)`); do not use icon-based selectors as they are Ionicons. (6) API clone: POST /api/decider-store/bmp-55-patterns/clone {mode:'full'} → 200 with `decision_id` in body (not `id`). (7) Delete decision: DELETE /api/decisions/{decision_id}. (8) List publishers: GET /api/adtaker/publishers → {publishers:[...]}. (9) On the AdMaker Studio bid modal, since super admin isn't a solution-store owner for BMP options, the eligible-options list is empty by design — no 'Place bid' click should be attempted.
